title: Private Medicare Plans Are Raising Costs And Forcing Millions To Find New Insurance
partialText: As enrollment for Medicare Advantage begins this month, older Americans are confronting fewer options because insurers are discontinuing coverage in many areas.

title: Kansas Senate Race Is a Surprising New Midterm Fight
partialText: Republicans are suddenly racing to defend a seat in Kansas, where Democrats are trying to win a Senate race for the first time in nearly a century.

title: Trump Says He Will Import Russian Diesel Fuel Amid High Prices
partialText: President Trump said Russia had agreed to ship potentially millions of tons of diesel fuel in the coming months. But Russia has an ongoing ban on exporting diesel.

title: Trump Announces White House Inquiry Into Fed Governor Lisa Cook
partialText: President Trump said the White House would investigate unsubstantiated claims that Lisa D. Cook committed mortgage fraud and hold a hearing next month.

title: Trump Administration Hits International Criminal Court With Severe Sanctions
partialText: U.S. officials announced the new, sweeping punishments just hours after the Nobel Peace Prize committee gave its annual honor to a former court judge.

title: Ashley St. Clair Was Offered Millions for Her Silence on Elon Musk. She Spoke Out Instead.
partialText: In the documentary “Musk,” Ashley St. Clair, a former right-wing influencer and mother of one of Musk’s children, speaks about her relationship with him.

title: What to Know About the New Elon Musk Documentary
partialText: A supersized portrait of the world’s richest man reveals new details and resurfaces troubling incidents from a headline-making life.

title: Some G.O.P. Lawmakers Pan Hegseth’s Plan to Stream Execution of Fort Hood Shooter
partialText: Some G.O.P. members of Congress said that broadcasting the execution of the Fort Hood shooter was inappropriate, though others gleefully applauded it.

title: Vance Says He Would Not Watch Livestreamed Execution of Fort Hood Shooter
partialText: The vice president also cast doubt on whether the public execution of Maj. Nidal Malik Hasan, the 2009 Fort Hood gunman, would go forward as Pentagon officials have planned.

title: He Left Behind Millions. Who Would Get It — His Family, or the D.S.A.?
partialText: When a New York University professor died in 2024, it set off a legal dispute over a quietly accumulated fortune.

title: Attacker in FlyDubai Flight Meant to Crash Into Israeli Airport, Emiratis Say
partialText: The attorney general of the United Arab Emirates said that the co-pilot had been inspired by the Sept. 11 attacks after  years of developing extreme Islamist views.

title: ICE Shooting in New York: What We Know
partialText: A 28-year-old man was shot by a federal immigration agent in New York City on Thursday. Mayor Zohran Mamdani said agents were “terrorizing our city.”

title: Mike Ditka, Fiery Coach of the Chicago Bears, Has Died
partialText: He and the Bears won the Super Bowl in 1986, and after coaching he became one of the sport’s most visible and enduring talking heads. He was 86.

title: His Unmarked Grave Lay Forgotten for 200 Years. They Had to Fix That.
partialText: The identity of a Scottish sailor killed in Connecticut after a skirmish during the War of 1812 long remained a mystery until two local history buffs got involved.

title: Navi Pillay, South African Jurist, Is Awarded the Nobel Peace Prize
partialText: The choice drew condemnation from Israel over Ms. Pillay’s role leading a U.N. commission that said the country had committed genocide against Palestinians.

title: Israel Denounces the Decision to Award the Nobel Peace Prize to Navi Pillay
partialText: Ms. Pillay, a human rights lawyer, was drawn into the international spotlight last year as chair of a commission that found that Israel had committed genocide in Gaza.

title: Zohran Mamdani’s Moral Obscenity
partialText: A mayor for one million Jewish New Yorkers fails his duty.

title: Want to Avoid Another Jan. 6? Defeat These Republicans.
partialText: The 2028 election is on the ballot right now.

title: Donor Says Kimberly Guilfoyle Sought Money From Him to Cover Debt
partialText: Correspondence suggests that Ms. Guilfoyle, the U.S. ambassador to Greece and former fiancée of Donald Trump Jr., asked a G.O.P. donor to pay off her credit card.
